title: Mediterranean culinary herbs
summary: Grow useful herbs without overwatering drought-tolerant species.
steps: Select correctly identified culinary species such as oregano, thyme, rosemary, sage, parsley, basil or mint.
Separate plants by water need; basil and parsley generally differ from woody Mediterranean herbs.
Use sharply drained soil for drought-tolerant woody herbs and avoid permanently wet roots.
Keep invasive spreaders such as mint in controlled containers where needed.
Harvest clean healthy growth before severe stress and never substitute a wild plant without positive identification.
